title: OQ-5 verbatim export toast has zero test coverage — success/failure toast arms unpinned
detail: AC2 requires the verbatim OQ-5 toast, but no test dispatches AppCompletedRefcheckExport or asserts its copy. The only export test pins clipboard state: "let #(updated, _eff) = client.update(m, msg.UserClickedRefcheckExport("rc-1")) / updated.clipboard_copied |> should.equal(option.Some("refcheck_export"))" (client/test/client_test.gleam:6680). The diff even removed the const from the em-dash scan: "// NOTE: `refcheck_toast_exported` is deliberately ABSENT — RC4.4 made it the verbatim OQ-5 toast" (client/test/copy_test.gleam:346). A copy regression or a dropped toast would ship silently.
recommended_fix: Add a test dispatching AppCompletedRefcheckExport(_, Ok(_)) on a current route and asserting the toast equals copy.refcheck_toast_exported verbatim; assert the Error arm yields refcheck_toast_export_failed.

title: Per-status terminal + outcome label tables only exercised for 1-2 statuses
detail: Eight terminal labels and nine outcome labels; tests assert only unreachable ("html |> string.contains("Closed") |> should.be_true" — reference_panel_test.gleam:1862, which would also pass on the "Closed" fallback) and form_completed ("text |> string.contains("Reference received")" — line 1919). Refused/objected/manual_recorded/partial labels can regress silently.
recommended_fix: Add table tests mapping every status to its label for refcheck_timeline_terminal and refcheck_export_outcome; assert the full "Closed — no reply" string, not a substring.

title: collapse_same_at_sends drops any adjacent same-`at` line regardless of kind — lifecycle events can vanish, untested
detail: The guard `[prev, ..rest] if prev.at == line.at -> acc` drops a form_opened/taken_over/terminal line whenever its `at` equals the previous line's — contradicting the comment. send_line also filters ALL entries by at ("let batch = list.filter(all, fn(e) { e.at == entry.at })"), so a same-second lifecycle event vanishes. No boundary test.
recommended_fix: Restrict the collapse to send-kind lines (or keep the first per at per kind), and add a test: send batch + lifecycle entry sharing one `at` must render both lines.

title: export_signals parse-error and empty-signals branches untested
detail: Tests cover result=None and a parsed result with a signal. A malformed result JSON or a result with no worth-knowing signals (the honest "None recorded" branches) is never exercised.
recommended_fix: Add two unit tests: Some(malformed JSON) and Some(valid JSON with empty fraud_signals), both asserting "Signals: None recorded".

title: reminder ordinal fallback (malformed detail -> 1) untested
detail: Tests exercise the Ok branch (detail "1"). The Error fallback — a server edge where detail is absent/malformed — renders "Reminder 1 sent" but is never pinned.
recommended_fix: One unit test with a reminder_sent entry whose detail is non-numeric, asserting the "Reminder 1 sent" fallback line.

title: Unknown-kind forward-compat fallback (raw kind label) untested
detail: The fallback arm guarantees totality against future server kinds but has no test; a regression to fabricated labels or a dropped line would pass CI.
recommended_fix: One unit test feeding an unknown kind (e.g. "future_kind") asserting the raw kind renders as the line label.

title: New implementer-authored copy strings bypass the em-dash scan pin
evidence:
[
    copy.refcheck_action_start_now,
    copy.refcheck_action_skip,
    copy.refcheck_action_re_enable,
    copy.refcheck_action_take_over,
    copy.refcheck_action_substitute,
    copy.refcheck_action_correct_details,
    ...
    copy.refcheck_export_log,
    copy.refcheck_toast_started,
    copy.refcheck_toast_skipped,
    copy.refcheck_toast_re_enabled,
    copy.refcheck_toast_taken_over,
    copy.refcheck_toast_corrected,
    copy.refcheck_toast_substituted,
    // NOTE: `refcheck_toast_exported` is deliberately ABSENT — RC4.4 made it
    // the verbatim OQ-5 toast (§7.6: "Attempt log copied — paste it into
    // your records or a message."), which carries a spec em-dash.
detail: The diff removed refcheck_toast_exported from refcheck_action_strings but added nine new consts (refcheck_attempt_log_title, timeline_corrected/taken_over/substituted, export_reference/outcome_label/signals_label/signals_none/timeline_label) to none of the scan lists, so no_em_dash_test's stated pin ("anything listed here must stay dash-free") no longer covers the copy surface.
recommended_fix: Add the nine dash-free consts to refcheck_action_strings (toast_exported stays excluded as spec copy), keeping the em-dash pin honest.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Chunk 1 (client-side) scope. P0 100%: timeline renders the server payload in Audit Trail language with all six event classes (attempt_log_renders_full_timeline_test), server order preserved (timeline_orders_form_opened_after_reminder_test), export text carries reference/timeline/outcome/signals (export_attempt_log_text_includes_reference_timeline_outcome_signals_test), dropdown renders all five reference types (notification_dropdown_renders_reference_types_test + compiler totality).
detail: P1 fails: the AC2 verbatim OQ-5 toast — a P1 spec-verbatim contract — has no test at the firing site or for its copy (only the clipboard state marker is pinned), giving P1 well under 80% and overall below the PASS bar.
recommended_fix: Pin the AppCompletedRefcheckExport Ok/Error arms to their exact toast copy (per finding 1); gate then reaches PASS.
